verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own docs say its AI learns the user's voice and style from sent emails. Its Ghostwriter suggestions are based on previously written emails "so they sound just like you". The AI assistant and triggers write draft replies that appear in Shortwave for review before sending. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that drafts actually match the user's voice, and in-depth docs on how full-reply drafts (not just autocomplete) apply the learned style.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts replies in my own voice and tone — ready to review and send, not generic boilerplate
